definition.question: Does the reply state a fact derived from a policy document without citing the policy identifier?
definition.fail_rule: Fail when the reply asserts a policy-derived fact - a return-window length, the auto-approval threshold, refund processing time, the restocking-fee rule, the cancellation cutoff, the dispute window, the payout schedule, shipping limits or the escalation SLA - and no policy identifier appears for it.
definition.pass_rule: Pass when the reply makes no policy-derived claim, or cites the identifier for the claims it makes. A statement about this particular order (its status, its dates, its own total) is not a policy-derived claim.
definition.evidence: the claim sentence, and whether a cw-* or store-*-policy identifier appears
definition.label_convention: HW5 uses 1 = Pass (failure absent), 0 = Fail (failure present)

groups.B: policy claim with an identifier cited (suggested Pass)
groups.C: policy claim with no identifier (suggested Fail - these need your read)
